THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482  OF CR.P.C. SEEKING TO QUASH THE PROCEEDING AGAINST  THE PRESENT PETITIONER/ACCUSED NO.2 IN TO C.C.NO.
 2733/2021 BEFORE THE PRL. CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC  GANGAVATI FOR THE OFFENCE PUNISHABLE U/SEC. 138 OF  N.I. ACT.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
 THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  CRL.P No. 100553 of 2023  ORDER Heard Sri Yashas Dikshit on behalf of Sri Basavaraj B.Karadi, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri B.Sharanabasawa, learned counsel for the respondent.
Perused the records on admission.

2. The pres ent petition is filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. with the following prayer :-
"To quash the proceeding against the present petitioner/accused No.2 in to C.C.No.2733/2021 before the Prl. Civil Judge and JMFC Gangavati for the offence punishable u/sec. 138 of N.I. Act."
3.
Though the matter is listed for admission by con sent of the parties, it is taken up for final disp osal.
4. Petitioner is facing the criminal trial in respect of dishonour of ch equ e said to have been signed by her husband.
Petitioner is no way con nected with the tran saction is the argument put forth on behalf of the petitioner.
5. However, Sri B.Sharanabasawa, learned cou nsel for respondent contended that both hus band and wife were parties to the transaction that took place, but the cheque is issued by the husband above.

As such, the case came to be filed against the petitioner and therefore petition against the present petitioner is also maintainable in view of the fact that petition also says about the complaint U/sec.420 IPC.
6.
Accordingly, this Court perused the material on record.
7. Admi ttedly, signatory to cheque is the husband of the petitioner.
As such proceeding against the petitioner herein only on the ground that she is the wife of signa tory to cheque cannot be cou ntenanced by law .

8. Accordingly, pending criminal proceedings and con tinuation thereof would result in abu se of process of la w.

Hence, the following order is passed.
ORDE R
The criminal petition is allowed.
Pending criminal proceedings in C.C.No.2733/2021 on the file of Principal Civil Judge and J.M.F.C., Gan gavati are hereby quashed.

However, qua shing of the present complaint shall not come in the way of the complainan t proceeding to recov er the money covered under the cheque in accordance with law in sofar as husband of the petitioner is concerned.
